easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning a land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 5.
